creator: Alexander Terp
description: a_32xp8grzh fixed the first sign of a foreign ssh master (it answers -O check but carries no forward). The card named a second: daemon.remote.starting failing every ~30 s with 'another daemon is already serving' while the far daemon is healthy. The restart path (crates/muster-seam/src/session/starting_again.rs) still asks only the control socket, so a restart attempt can race tunnel recovery. Decide whether repeated refusals should trigger a tunnel reopen. Raised by factory run muster-1119-iris.
title: A start refused with 'already serving' over and over should make the supervisor suspect the tunnel
